Rebuild of the v0.1.68 server line with no behaviour change, published by the repository's new release pipeline instead of by hand.

## Server

### Changed
- The bundle no longer carries the build machine's directory layout, and the shipped mod scripts no longer carry internal references. Same server, clean binaries.
- Releases are now built and published by CI from a tag. Every bundle is checked before publication for its version stamp, its layout, its contents and the pinned in-game runtime, and then checked again against the bytes the release actually serves.
- The UE4SS runtime that ships inside the bundle is pinned by hash, so a release cannot silently pick up a different core.
- The internal HTTP signing and password-gate readiness checks were split into their own units and covered by tests. No behaviour difference.
